subject: section-11-constraints
narrative: Audit of the nine invariants HANDOFF section 11 declares must not be broken, each re-derived against the tree at be2a27d. Five hold. Four do not, and none of the four is a near miss: the write boundary does not cover Bash, 209 of 621 findings carry no language, the accelerator export has an open task saying it leaks project text, and the agent count the same document twice states as eight is nine. Method: one command per claim, named in each note. No claim was scored from reading prose about it.

claims.claim: Delete-and-rebuild must stay lossless; nothing exists only in the index
claims.note: seven conformance assertions turn on a byte-identical rebuild

claims.claim: No core agent names a stack-specific tool; everything indirects through project-profile.md
claims.note: the only stack tool named anywhere under agents/ is cargo fmt, in an illustrative sentence, in an agent added after the core eight

claims.claim: The kit never writes outside the project root
claims.note: the guard matcher is Write|Edit|NotebookEdit, so Bash writes are unguarded; MEASUREMENTS records kit-task.sh creating files cross-root without tripping it

claims.claim: The kit is inert without project-profile.md
claims.note: kit_active has one definition and 19 callers across tooling/

claims.claim: Findings carry language and defect class from day one
claims.note: 0 of 621 findings lack class, but 209 lack lang; the claim holds for class and fails for language

claims.claim: Accelerator export stays aggregate-only by construction, not by convention
claims.note: that task is state open and asserts the export leaks project text and its counts can be forged

claims.claim: Skill AND agent counts stay fixed
claims.note: the same document states eight agents at :199 and :288; the tree holds nine, so the count moved and the constraint did not bind

claims.claim: Topology beats priority; cycles are withheld, not reordered
claims.note: 19 occurrences of withheld; layering is Kahn and score ranks only within a layer
no .mcp.json anywhere in the tree and no mcpServers key in the plugin manifest
